info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Payments Payments Webhooks-v2-spec
info.description: The Payment Webhook Status API enables consumers to retrieve the status of payments processed through webhooks. This endpoint provides real-time updates on payment transactions, allowing developers to monitor and validate the flow of payments seamlessly. Typical use cases include integrating with payment processing systems and ensuring operational continuity in financial applications. This API is essential for developers looking to maintain synchronization between payment events and their application’s user interface.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current status of the payment webhook, which is used to receive payment notifications and updates. It is essential for ensuring synchronization between your application and the payment provider.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to handle webhook events related to payment transactions. It contains information that should be posted to the endpoint whenever an event occurs, allowing for real-time updates and actions based on payment status changes. Clients need to send valid JSON data conforming to the specified schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully and returned the expected data.

ListPaymentsPaymentsWebhooksRequest.description: A string representation of the request body for the GET operation of the payment webhook.

status.description: Indicates the success or failure of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the transaction.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the payment.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the audit of the operation.

x-processing-time.description: This header indicates the total time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request. A value of 0 indicates that the request was processed nearly instantaneously.
